examples.scenario: Title: Emily Rewrites the Co-Parent Opener Scenario: You see the child's rain boots by the front door, the pickup calendar on the shelf, and a bedtime note that contradicts yesterday's plan. Emily must decide how to start with her co-parent. She changes "you are undermining me" into "I think we may have different ideas about what tantrums need from us."
